main_text.p: R E M P. [?] omnis de Rep. consilij fundamentum, omnis in Repub. rectè administrandâ, prudentiæ fons est & scaturigo uberrima. Quare immortales gratias, ut Frisia omnis, sic nominatim Groninga vestra & Omlandia debent æternumque debebunt ingenio clarissimo Historici sui inclyti Ubbonis Emmii, cujus Spiritu Resp. vestra etiam post fata ejus subinde renascitur, nunquam intermoritura. Cui Patriæ suæ [?] cum bonum civem quemvis favere & opitulari, quantum in se est, conveniat, ego meo loco impensâ operâque obstetricari studio curæque habui singulari. Quare non tantum Syntagma illud præclarum, quod Cl. Emmius de statu rerum deque jure Provinciæ hujus felici stylo condiderat, cum distractis exemplaribus passim illud expeti ab amantibus patriæ cognovissem, recudendum suscepi, sed simul operam dedi, ut cultius nitidiusque prodiret, tum aliis, quæ cuilibet perlustranti facile erit agnoscere, tum imprimis Geographicâ tabulâ geminâ, quarum altera Urbis, altera totius

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "Patriæ suæ" is only partly legible (the printed form seems to be a compound ending in -γενεσία, probably παλιγγενεσία, with a prefix); it is marked [?] and not transcribed with certainty. "REMP." in small capitals is uncertain ([?]). The text ends on "totius" at the right, which is the catchword, not part of the paragraph. The stray marks in the margins are not text. A "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right is excluded.
